name: Reel Spirit Luxury Charters
summary: Reel Spirit runs private fishing charters and coastal cruises on a Super Sport 48 yacht from Port Ferdinand Marina near Speightstown. Fishing trips run inshore for families and beginners or offshore for wahoo, barracuda and mahi mahi, and most cruises stop to snorkel reefs and wrecks. Food and drink packages and watersports can be added.
standouts: Super Sport 48 Ocean Yacht with three bedrooms, air conditioning and two restrooms with showers
Captain and crew are CPR certified
Shimano fishing gear and a fighting chair on board

Every price block also shows 'PRICE UPON REQUEST', which looks like a toggled element; prices recorded as displayed. No booking widget: the 'book now' buttons lead to /book-live/, a request form (name, email, phone, date, message) where the operator replies, so bookingLinks are empty. Booking page says they operate from several ports around Barbados; Port Ferdinand Marina is the stated base. Deposit is taken at booking; cash, bank transfer and crypto accepted. The about page says the boat appeared in the Netflix series Outer Banks. The boat does not take wheelchair users. A FishingBooker reviews badge appears on the charters page; it was not opened.
